key_insight: ComputeWise finds that unaided AI research agents spend only 52% of GPU time on necessary work, while its harness removes over 80% of extra time to the answer across five models.
engineering_relevance: Improving experiment orchestration can reduce costly GPU waste that utilization metrics alone fail to reveal.
method: Benchmark agents on research tasks using a simulated GPU that replays recorded runs.
Measure necessary computation, unnecessary computation, and idle time.
Combine prompting with deterministic orchestration code to reduce waste.
evidence_signal: Hundreds of simulated experiments found 52% necessary work, 22% unnecessary work, and 26% idle time; simple speed prompts, utilization prompts, and a job scheduler did not fix the waste.
watch_item: Replay-based simulation enables broad testing, but savings on real GPUs and workloads beyond the benchmark require validation.
paper_title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
